description: Create app/lib/api/search.ts with typed API functions and types, then wire SearchResults.tsx (client component) and app/page.tsx (server component) to use real API data instead of mock arrays.
steps:
3. UPDATE app/page.tsx. Convert to async server component (it already is — just not fetching). Add at the top of the function body:

  ```ts
  const [featuredHotels, cityCounts] = await Promise.allSettled([
    fetchFeaturedHotels(),
    fetchCityCounts(),
  ]);
  const featured = featuredHotels.status === 'fulfilled' ? featuredHotels.value : [];
  const cities = cityCounts.status === 'fulfilled' ? cityCounts.value : [];
  ```

  Replace the hardcoded `featuredHotels` const with `featured`.
  Replace the hardcoded `destinations` const with a mapped version of `cities` that merges with the static gradient palette (keep gradient colors for known cities, fall back to default for unknown ones).

  The CITY_GRADIENTS map:
  ```ts
  const CITY_GRADIENTS: Record<string, { gradientFrom: string; gradientTo: string }> = {
    'Lagos':         { gradientFrom: '#d4a574', gradientTo: '#8b5e3c' },
    'Abuja':         { gradientFrom: '#7a9e7e', gradientTo: '#3d6b4f' },
    'Port Harcourt': { gradientFrom: '#6b8cba', gradientTo: '#2d4a6b' },
    'Uyo':           { gradientFrom: '#c4956a', gradientTo: '#8b6343' },
    'Kano':          { gradientFrom: '#b8956a', gradientTo: '#7a5c3a' },
    'Kaduna':        { gradientFrom: '#8a9e8a', gradientTo: '#4a6b4a' },
  };
  ```

  When `cities` is empty (API returned no data / failed), fall back to the previous hardcoded `destinations` array. Similarly when `featured` is empty, fall back to the previous `featuredHotels` array.

  HotelCard on the homepage does not have an `id` prop, so there is no link to the detail page yet — that is fine for this feature.

  Import fetchFeaturedHotels and fetchCityCounts from @/app/lib/api/search.
acceptance_criteria: `npx next build` completes with no TypeScript errors
app/lib/api/search.ts compiles clean with all exported types and functions
app/page.tsx no longer has hardcoded featuredHotels or destinations arrays (falls back gracefully when API is empty)
SearchResults renders a loading state, error state, and empty state correctly
Pagination controls show correct totals from API response
verification: npx next build from c:\Users\Pkaka\music\hotel-os — must complete with exit code 0 and no TypeScript errors
findings: Next.js 16 with cacheComponents:true rejects prerendering pages that call fetch with cache:'no-store' unless the page exports `instant = false`. The homepage required `export const instant = false` to allow blocking prerender. FEAT-002 (hotel detail page) will likely need the same treatment if it calls serverFetch for real API data. The hotels/[id]/page.tsx currently uses generateStaticParams sourced from SEARCH_MOCK_HOTELS — when wiring it to real API data, generateStaticParams will need updating or removing, and the page will need `instant = false` if it does no-store fetches. HotelCard does not accept an `id` prop, so hotel detail links from the homepage are not yet functional — the id must be passed separately when HotelCard is updated to support linking.
